key_insight: Selecting and fusing diverse quantum and classical models can outperform choosing a single best variational quantum circuit, with diversity helping drive better predictions.
engineering_relevance: For quantum ML pipeline design, the result suggests architecture search should preserve and exploit model diversity rather than only optimizing one top-performing circuit.
method: Built a pool of 29 structurally diverse classical models and quantum circuits.
Used Combinatorial Fusion Analysis (CFA) with rank-score function (RSF) and cognitive diversity (CD) to select maximally diverse subsets.
Combined selected models using score and rank fusion to form hybrid classical-quantum ensembles.
evidence_signal: Across four binary classification benchmarks, the CFA-based fusion consistently beat the best individual model, with accuracy gains up to 6.03% and superior results versus related literature on all datasets.
watch_item: The approach depends on identifying a diverse candidate pool, so gains may be limited if quantum circuit search spaces or evaluation budgets are small.
paper_title: Diversity-Aware Ensemble of Quantum-Classical Models via Combinatorial Fusion
